name: crosstab
description: Compute a cross-tabulation (contingency table) from a DataFrame — frequency counts, or an aggregation of ``values``.
usage: ``index`` and ``columns`` (both required) are the column name(s) forming the rows and columns of the table. Omit ``values`` for frequency counts, or set it with ``aggregate`` to summarise. ``totals`` adds a margins row/column.

attributes.name: reset_index
attributes.description: If ``True`` (default), reset the result index after the cross-tab.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Engine to use: ``crosstab`` (pandas crosstab, default) or ``pivot`` (pandas pivot_table).

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: Column name(s) used as the cross-tab row index. A single name or a list.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Column name(s) used as the cross-tab columns. A single name or a list.

attributes.name: values
attributes.description: Column(s) to aggregate. Omit for plain frequency counts.

attributes.name: aggregate
attributes.description: Aggregation function applied to ``values`` (pandas ``aggfunc``), e.g. ``count``, ``sum``, ``mean``. Defaults to frequency counts when omitted.

attributes.name: totals
attributes.description: Add a totals/margins row and column (pandas ``margins``).

json_schema.title: crosstab

reset_index.description: If ``True`` (default), reset the result index after the cross-tab.

type.description: Engine to use: ``crosstab`` (pandas crosstab, default) or ``pivot`` (pandas pivot_table).

aggregate.description: Aggregation function applied to ``values`` (pandas ``aggfunc``), e.g. ``count``, ``sum``, ``mean``. Defaults to frequency counts when omitted.

name.description: Label for the totals row/column (pandas margins_name).

json_schema.description: Cross-tabulate a DataFrame. ``index`` and ``columns`` are required.

columnRef.description: A single column name or a list of column names.
